update_2026_11_23_26l_ag: Judged on 2026-11-23, the first session after the delivery of seed epoch AG (brain 420c887, 'Tohum dönemi: snowball-mcp f07da0d'), by tohum/26l; answer line CHANGELOG-16. Each item was read on the pages as they are at that commit, not taken from the answer line. (1) kos writes the file of a kept output whose path is candidates/<id>/package.json to that same path of its results, the organ writes to no path of the results itself; an <id> that is no candidate id is candidate_id_invalid with nothing written, an <id> two outputs carry with different bytes is package_id_twice with neither written, the same bytes twice are one package, and each refusal is of that id only (26p:37-42). (2) diff is a JSON string and the diff is its UTF-8 bytes; a diff with no UTF-8 form cannot be a run-time candidate in stage 1; the gate reads the diff of the package whose hash the rerun entry carries and nothing else (26p:43-46). (3) a package that is not UTF-8 JSON, not an object, or has no such diff is package_unusable for that candidate only (26p:47-48). (4) the three gate files stand under r/<id>/ and reruns.<id> carries verdict, reasons and package_sha256 (26p:49-51). (5) package_missing, rerun_missing and rerun_files_missing are named on yaz's target line and are no gate reason and no cause (26p:52-58). (6) the bound on the number of packages is deferred to the epoch that brings stage 1 MF5, before that MF's live run; until then a package is bounded by operating.output_bytes of its organ run and all reruns by operating.kos_wall_s (26p:59-63): an explicit deferral with the bounds that hold meanwhile. (7) the rerun runs on a fresh copy of the job's base run's worktree, the one the ready candidates use (26p:64-66). The vector note was decided against (26p:67). Every item has a rule or a named deferral; no successor. Where the page differs from what was built, read in the code in this session and not yet repaired (one job a session; both are in this session's blocked row and come before MF12 is counted, CHANGELOG-16 first job): (A) the candidate id of the page has no dot ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}); referee/runner/kos.py:203 CANDIDATE_ID allows '.', and the same pattern is read as the target id and the organ id by loop/cek.py and loop/pulled.py, so the repair gives the candidate id its own rule and does not narrow the other two on this page's word. (B) a rerun whose verdict is not verified is not 'none': the candidate reaches the gate and is rejected with kos:<reason> for each of its entry's reasons; referee/runner/candidate_rerun.py:151 raises rerun_not_verified and hands out nothing, and tests/test_candidate_rerun.py:213-221 fix that. The check therefore binds only what was adopted as built: (1) without the dot rule, (2), (4) and the missing-rerun and missing-files reasons of (5).
